title: A Prom for the Tryouts
author: P. M. Crane
blurb: Marguerite Lockridge, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
